body: alongwith respondent No.3 and submit that in compliance of impugned order, F.I.R bearing Crime No. 151/ 2026 under section 489-F P.P.C has been registered at P.S Satellite Town Mirpurkhas, therefore, this Criminal Misc. Application has become infructuous.

Since impugned order dated 21-08-2026 passed in Criminal Misc. Application No. 1353/ 2026 by learned Additional Sessions Judge-II/Ex-Officio Justice of Peace, Mirpurkhas has been complied with, therefore, instant Criminal Misc. Application has become infructuous, hence same alongwith pending listed application is hereby dismissed.
